sentences.text: Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:7407 Court No. - 79 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 483 No. - 1621 of 2023 Applicant :- R. Jairaman

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anurag Vajpeyi,Prateek Dwivedi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused material on record.

The present application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to issue direction to the court concerned to conclude the proceedings of complaint bearing Case No. 899 of 2009 under Sections 7/16 The Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, Police Station Sector-58 Noida, District Gautam Budh Nagar, pending before Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-1, Gautam Budh Nagar.

entities.text: Police Station Sector-58 Noida, District Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-1, Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that in this case, a case no. 899 of 2009 is pending before the court concerned since the year 2009, therefore requested to issue direction to the court concerned to decide the case within a stipulated period.

entities.text: R. Jairaman vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has also no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submission made by learned counsel for applicant as well as learned A.G.A., it is expedient to direct the court concerned to make its endeavour to conclude the proceedings of the case in accordance with law within a period of one year, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment or any stay order from this Court or by the Hon'ble Apex Court.
With the aforesaid directions, the present application stands disposed of finally.
